known_pre_repair_defect: Current corpus builder silently skips evidence_refs whose type is not file.
hypothesis: Every mandatory evidence reference must either materialize into immutable reviewer-visible evidence with a hash, or fail closed explicitly as unavailable/unsupported; no declared evidence may disappear silently.

cases.input: file ref exists at exact candidate commit

cases.required: explicit materialization failure; never identifier-only success
materialized count equals declared count or entire operation fails closed

pass_criteria: every materialized object has deterministic sha256
candidate file refs are bound to exact candidate commit
non-file evidence requires a trusted resolver/broker
missing/unsupported mandatory evidence cannot produce a promotable corpus
